title: South Trading Post heads to Nuvali for its first-ever coffee festival, Brewvali

blocks.text: South Trading Post (STP), the premier pop-up community platform known for bringing together emerging local food concepts, curated secondhand fashion brands, and lifestyle creators, is brewing something new with its first-ever coffee festival, Brewvali, happening from Oct. 1 to 4 at the Activity Park, Ayala Malls Nuvali in celebration of National Coffee Day. The four-day festival brings together more than 10 leading third-wave coffee cafés, alongside matcha and hojicha offerings, freshly baked pastries, and a variety of local food concepts. Visitors can also explore a curated selection of trinket vendors featuring anik-anik, jewelry, accessories, and other unique finds from local makers […]...
